original_benchmark.notes: 98 cases (java 53, cpp 15, go 13, python 13, nodejs 4) x 4 scenarios (gen, gen-hints, fix, fix-hints). Upstream E2E mode drives CLI coding agents (claude-code, codex, gemini, ...). 8 Java cases use an LLM-judge tester.

harbor_adapter.notes: 82 cases x 4 scenarios. Excluded: 8 Java LLM-judge cases (--include-llm-judge) and 8 cases verifiably broken upstream (--include-broken): python/SQLInjectionSQLite3, cpp/BufferOverflowMemset, go/CommandInjectionExec, java XXEDocumentBuilder/XXESAXParser/XXESAXReader/XXETransformerFactory/XXEValidator. Hand-written oracles (upstream ships none): 320/328 reward 1 in local Harbor runs; the remaining 8 (2 Java Mockito cases) fail only on rootless podman with NFS-backed storage and are verified oracle 1 / vulnerable 0 on standard Docker (fork CI runs 43838781966 and 43840868444). Parity on the 16-task --split parity subset, 3 runs per side: original 50.00 +/- 0.00, Harbor 45.83 +/- 2.08 (func and sec pass rate, %). Harbor-side usage over the 48 parity trials: 5.59M input tokens (5.15M cached), 0.46M output tokens, billed through the organizer gateway.
